title: Unnumbered system head curve label in Figure 4.8
applicability: Figure 4.8 'System head curves with change in pipe sizes' (Source: CPHEEO, 1993). The lower curve is labelled Hf + v²/2g, the annotation above the upper curve reads 'INCREASE IN HEAD LOSS IN PIPE', and the axes are H and Q.
notes: The same label is already transcribed for Figure 4.6 (SEW-2013-A:Ep289-1); this is the separate printed instance inside Figure 4.8 on page 290.
p290-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number. No symbol definitions or units are printed in the figure; the leading term is printed as 'Hf' without a subscript.
